notes.title: Full version release
notes.notes:
[h1]Main changes in the full version[/h1]
[list]
[*] added story insert
[*] game settings are displayed in the pause menu
[*] player character movement speed is increased
[*] resources are now accumulated faster and in greater quantities
[*] when using the mouse, shooting backwards is allowed
[*] mana consumption is adjusted for more comfortable play
[*] sound design is changed
[*] new music is added - less intrusive (the old one can be selected in the settings)
[/list]

notes.title: Tutorial level and Balance update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The tutorial level is now more detailed.
[*] Simple enemies in the forest and on the volcano have been weakened. Now Daria finishes them off with two shots on normal difficulty, and with one shot on very easy difficulty.
[*] The number of players no longer affects the HP of bosses so much.
[/list]

notes.title: Small balance changes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Gribski has become stronger
[*] The spawn of the inhabitants is balanced in the cursed village. Witches don't appear indefinitely
[/list]
